title.zh: 勾股定理 · 一步一交互
title.en: The Pythagorean Theorem · One Interaction at a Time

desc.zh: a²+b²=c² 不是背出来的：3-4-5 先露馅，再用面积灌注和拼图把等式拼出来，拖着顶点怎么拖都等，最后反过来判角、算梯子，并撞见怎么也写不尽的 √2。
desc.en: a²+b²=c², earned rather than memorised: the 3-4-5 coincidence first, then area pouring and a jigsaw proof, dragging the vertex without breaking equality, classifying angles in reverse, a ladder problem, and finally √2 — the length no fraction can write.
